issue_text:
joshuadavidthomas/django-language-server#180 (by joshuadavidthomas): Setup server logging to file using standard XDG dir
Follow up to #170, right now we're just logging to `/tmp` but we should really use the XDG standard dir for this -- especially because we have the `directories` crate right there.
discussion:
[2025-10-18T16:06:58Z commented by joshuadavidthomas]
@copilot logic for the location of the logging dir should be in the conf crate and exported from it and used in the server crate.

[2025-10-18T16:14:47Z commented by Copilot]
> @copilot logic for the location of the logging dir should be in the conf crate and exported from it and used in the server crate. 

Done. Added `log_dir()` function to djls-conf that returns the XDG cache directory, and updated djls-server to use it. The directories dependency has been removed from djls-server since it now uses the exported function. (commit: see above)
